name: Tropical Andes
region: Cordillera Blanca, Cordillera Real, Ecuadorian volcanoes (approximate) and the Bolivian Altiplano.
sources: Kaser, G. & Osmaston, H. (2002) Tropical Glaciers. Cambridge University Press
Georges, C. (2004) 20th-century glacier fluctuations in the tropical Cordillera Blanca, Peru. AAAR 36
Hersbach, H. et al. (2020) The ERA5 global reanalysis. QJRMS 146:1999-2049 (monthly climatology 1991-2020, 300 hPa winds)
notes: Nearly constant temperature through the year; a pronounced dry season (May-Sep) is the climbing season. Ecuador's equatorial volcanoes have a bimodal regime not captured here.
